text: In the last month the app has improved a lot, there are no widgets yet, but I'm very confident with how the development is progressing so I purchased the app to support the project. Great job so far, 5 stars deserved. Edit: The app has not had any major updates since..
author: Kebab
developer_reply: Thank you for your support and feedback! HabitDone is currently in its early stages. Many features are still being improved. We are currently releasing a new feature every 1-2 weeks. The Android widget is already in the works and will be coming soon. We are also working on enhancing the desired features. We will accelerate the development progress.

text: I love the interface, clean and minimalist.
author: Nicola

text: Molto bella la grafica, ma la versione gratuita ha solo 3 abitudini tracciabili.
author: Alessia M.
developer_reply: After investigation, 3 habits can satisfy most ordinary users. If your heavy users you can choose our PRO version, we will provide unlimited habits and other features. In addition, we will consider adding more habits to the free version in the future.
